topic: Selling unused gift cards for cash vs letting them expire in a drawer (Cassius vs Tovah)

scenes.narration: Americans sit on billions in unused gift cards gathering dust in drawers. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a fan of dusty gift cards, comic burst banner reads BILLIONS UNUSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cassius and Tovah each stashed six unused gift cards away.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man cassius and woman tovah in gym gear each holding six gift cards, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Together those forgotten cards hold around three hundred dollars value.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a spread of gift cards on a gym bench stamped THREE HUNDRED VALUE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cassius tosses his cards in a drawer and forgets them.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cassius shoving gift cards into a gym locker drawer, a banner reads FORGOTTEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two of his cards quietly expire and lose all value.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cassius frowning at two faded cards on a gym bench stamped EXPIRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tovah lists hers on a reputable gift-card resale site instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tovah on a gym mat listing cards on a laptop labeled RESALE SITE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sells each card for about ninety percent real cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tovah trading a gift card for cash near a gym bench, a tag stamped NINETY PERCENT CASH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That turns dusty plastic into two hundred seventy real dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tovah holding a cash stack in the gym, an arrow from cards to money stamped TWO SEVENTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Cassius still has cards worth nothing usable.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked cassius on a gym bench holding expired cards stamped WORTH NOTHING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tovah already spent her cash covering real everyday monthly needs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tovah paying for groceries with cash outside the gym, a banner reads REAL NEEDS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Unused cards help nobody just sitting forgotten in a drawer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a lonely gift card in an open gym locker drawer stamped SITTING IDLE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sell unused gift cards for cash before they expire. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle in the gym holding a clipboard reading SELL GIFT CARDS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
